findings.highlight: we should try anything at this point
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=いちる char=2]一縷の望みに賭けるべきだ
findings.governingReading: They should stake everything on one slender thread of hope.
findings.explanation: A desperate, singular possibility becomes indiscriminate trial of anything.

findings.evidenceJa: シロウの魔術を流してください
findings.governingReading: Please let your magecraft flow through me.
findings.explanation: The process and grammatical object change, producing crudely mechanical English.

findings.highlight: activate the strengthening magic faster than I ever have
findings.evidenceJa: かつてない鮮やかさで強化の魔術を起動させた
findings.governingReading: He activates Strengthening with unprecedented clarity and brilliance.
findings.explanation: Quality and vivid precision are mistranslated as speed.

findings.highlight: whether I am stronger or faster
findings.evidenceJa: 外見的に鋭さが増したとか、破壊力が向上したとか
findings.governingReading: whether her visible sharpness or destructive power has increased
findings.explanation: Saber’s object-like diagnostic categories become generic strength and speed.

findings.evidenceJa: 祈るように、セイバーは俺の魔術を受け入れてくれた
findings.governingReading: Saber accepts his magecraft as if in prayer.
findings.explanation: The defining devotional posture of her acceptance disappears.
